mods.name: Papou HUD
mods.description: Mostra in alto a sinistra nome, armatura e vita degli altri giocatori vicini, piu' una bussola con le coordinate in alto al centro.

releases.notes:
## What's new
- **Update check:** at startup Papou HUD checks for a newer release. If there is one, a single popup on the main menu offers to update. **Update** downloads the new version, which is installed automatically when you close the game. **Not now** asks again next launch.
- To turn it off, set `"checkForUpdates": false` in `config/papou.json`.
- Fixed the mod description: the friend panels are in the top-left corner.

![Update popup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vittoriopippi/papou_mc/main/docs/screenshots/update-popup.png)

## Upgrading from 1.0.0
1.0.0 has no update check, so do this one by hand: remove `papouhud-1.0.0.jar` from `.minecraft/mods` and add `papouhud-1.1.0.jar`. Later versions will offer to install themselves.

## Requirements
Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3 · Fabric API · Java 25

mods.name: Papou HUD
mods.description: Mostra in basso a sinistra nome, armatura e vita degli altri giocatori vicini, piu' una bussola in alto.

releases.notes:
First release of Papou HUD, a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2.

## Features
- **Friend panels** (top-left): name, worn armor with durability bars, armor points and hearts for every nearby player.
- **Compass** (top-center): directions with north in red and the current heading in degrees.
- **XYZ coordinates** under the compass.
- **Settings menu** to show/hide each element and rebind shortcuts.
- English and Italian translations.

## Default keys
`H` friend panels · `N` compass · `J` coordinates · `M` settings menu

## Requirements
Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3 · Fabric API · Java 25

## Install
Drop `papouhud-1.0.0.jar` and Fabric API into `.minecraft/mods`.
